args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1, error rate 0.18). Rolled back in all production regions to the most recent healthy production release, v2.2.9 (v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback completed successfully across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
